THE SWITCH PLAN

Thirty days, with an exit at every step.

The literal sequence we run. Coexistence first; migration when the pilot has earned it.

  1. 1

    Days 1–5: import and coexist

    Customers, catalogue, stock imported and reconciled with you. The ERP keeps the books. Jwero takes the customer-facing doors: WhatsApp, Instagram, catalogue links, the counter if you choose.

  2. 2

    Day 5: the written plan

    What changes, the migration path, a straight price, and the change-freeze dates around your season. Then it is your call.

  3. 3

    Days 7–14: go live, approvals on

    Every AI action waits in the approval queue from day one. Staff trained by role, in their language. Nothing sends without a tap.

  4. 4

    Day 30: the exit test

    Enquiries answered, prices consistent, day-close variance, your first growth report on your own data. If it fails, we stop and your data leaves with you.

  5. 5

    After: migrate the rest, or don’t

    Move the books when you are ready, or keep the bridge to Tally forever. Both are normal.

QUESTIONS

What people ask before they message.

How do I switch from my jewellery ERP to Jwero?

Customers, products and stock are imported for you, set-up takes a day, and you can run both systems side by side while your team settles in. Switch outside your busiest season.

Can I keep my ERP for accounts and use Jwero for everything customer-facing?

Yes, that is how most businesses start. Jwero takes WhatsApp, Instagram, the catalogue, the counter and schemes; books bridge to Tally or Zoho Books, or to your ERP’s ledger via export, for as long as you want to run both.

What if the pilot fails?

Then we stop, at the exit test, and your data leaves with you as CSV. A pilot on your own data is the point: you decide on your evidence, not our claims.

How long does a single store take?

A fifteen-minute call on day one, a pilot on your own data in days 2–5, a written plan on day 5, go-live with approvals on by day 14, your first growth report at day 30. The full sequence is on the “How it goes” page.

Will we lose the history in the old system?

No. Purchase history, customers, catalogue and stock import from Excel, CSV or the ERP’s export, deduplicated and reconciled with you. The old system can stay readable for as long as you keep it.

What changes for my CA?

Nothing she will notice. Books post to Jwero’s ledger and bridge to Tally or Zoho Books. GST, VAT or sales-tax ready invoices, credit and debit notes and the audit trail are there; e-invoice IRN generation is not yet, and we say so.
